description: Use this when the person asks which border crossing to take from where they are or will be. into is the country they are going to. Not for one crossing's lanes: use get_border_wait. Answers the crossings into the country named, from a town or lat and lon, ranked by the drive to each (Apple Maps) plus its wait now, each with the drive, the wait and the total.

into.description: the country they are going to: Ukraine, Poland, Canada

lane.description: cars (the default), trucks, coaches, walking, NEXUS, SENTRI, Ready Lane, FAST

name: find_best_crossing
title: Find the best crossing
